profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Experienced Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the internet industry. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science focused in Computer Science from California State University-Long Beach.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Work within biweekly sprints to develop and maintain web application base on business requirements. Develop multiple design and implementations to allow split URL and AB Testing. Create microsites base off of designer mockups. Work with AdOps team to integrate third party advertisement services. Collaborate with other teams in cross platform integration and enhancement.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Work directly with client to collect requirements and access goals. Plan development phases and implement them. Built web application base on requirements. Work on both front-end and back-end development. Create database design and updates. Integrate third party API. Manage timeline for projects. Maintain companies web service application, software functionality, and server configurations.

positions.title: Network Operation Center Analyst
positions.description: Responsible for SharePoint 2010 installation, configuration and administration. Network/Systems support (Server configuration), Data Center Facilities Support, Technology Customer Support & Systems Development. Sharepoint and SQL Server Administration

positions.title: Branch Administrator
positions.description: Insured successful completion of training events. Managed weekly inventory Recorded new enrollments. Completed corporate month end reports. Managed account receivables associated Microsoft’s software assurance program. Recovered aging invoices in collection. Completed customer service requests. Generated sales reports by request.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description: Managed company’s website. Processed employer identification numbers application through the IRS. Assembled welfare benefit plans finalized documents. Generated monthly anniversary letters. Produced documents for marketing campaign. Oversaw projects requested by the CFO and President. Record life, health, or annuity application and track its underwriting and examination requirements.

projects.title: Bundle
projects.description: An android mobile applications that communicates with a web service. The client application uses android 4.2, java, XML and communicates with the web services. The web service acts as a liason between the client application and Facebook. It stores information retrieved from Facebook using Facebook's graph api and return JSON to the client. The application allows users to share photo albums based on social events. Responsible for client side front-end development and some back-end.
